content.text: Leicester's Morocco midfielder Bilal El Khannouss, 21, is wanted by Sunderland, though West Ham and Monaco are also keen on the former Genk playmaker. (L'Equipe - in French, external)
Sunderland, Monaco, and Strasbourg have also shown interest, with the latter being where Petrovic had a successful loan period last season, earning the player of the season accolade.
